titre: Free bishop on b4. Take it? Look first! ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Albin Countergambit, the Lasker Trap (a classic): 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.e3 Bb4+ 5.Bd2 dxe3 6.Bxb4?? exf2+ 7.Ke2 fxg1=N+! (a queen would give no check) 8.Ke1 Qh4+ 9.Kd2 Nc6 10.Qe1 Qxe1+ 11.Kxe1 Nxb4, and Black is winning (Stockfish 16: -6). Better: 6.fxe3. Would you have taken the bishop? 👇
